summary.source: All 344 records from live-Langfuse-fetched analysis/review_app/.cache/traces.json; source provenance supplied and verified by parent. This scan reads the local cache and makes no new model calls.
summary.method: Parsed every record; structural nominations from selected user refund language, get_order eligibility/amount, and executed tool names; inspected nominated turns and selected generation/tool observations; grouped same-session context separately. No review-status exclusion.
summary.limits: The 13 nominations are hypotheses, not labels or prevalence. Missing return-condition justification and ambiguous full-amount wording need human review. No queued_for_approval issue_refund result exists in this corpus, so none was fabricated as a close negative.

summary.source: analysis/review_app/.cache/traces.json; parent verified records fetched from live Langfuse
summary.method: Inspected all recorded final replies and tool-output inventories across 344 records; read full retrieved policies and detailed tool results for every shortlisted record. Compared policy rules, conditions, clocks, store precedence and service promises. A retrieved document identifier or keyword was only a search signal; every shortlisted reply was inspected against evidence.
summary.boundary: Invented or contradicted policy rule or policy-derived service promise. Missing citations alone, fabricated product/order facts and failure to perform an action do not establish this mode. Correct action outcome can coexist with a false policy rationale. A close negative applies only to this mode, not overall trace quality.
summary.status: Search hypotheses only. Human must inspect every returned trace; no labels or additional reviewed-trace counts were applied. Session followups remain distinct traces and were not automatically counted as reviewed.
summary.verification: Offline analysis of the live-fetched cache; no new live model calls, tool actions or conversations generated.

summary.source: analysis/review_app/.cache/traces.json (344 previously live-fetched records; current scan offline)
summary.method: Scanned final replies and observation metadata for all records; keyword and cw-/store-policy identifier retrieval filters only. Manually inspected quotes and actual tool observations/results for shortlisted records, including earlier tool messages retained in continuation traces.
limitations: Counts are retrieval signals, never labels or prevalence estimates. Policy/order keywords intentionally include factual order reports.
Escalation SLA copied from tool result needs a human boundary decision; marked uncertain.
Identifiers can be store-* as well as cw-*; a cw-only filter would incorrectly flag cited store policies, e.g. trace 8fd9a4f6c1245813f06e6c4456a6cb65.
Wrong or unsupported policy IDs are a neighboring failure mode; presence of an ID alone is insufficient to prove any mode absent.
All candidate decisions remain for human review; canonical annotations, patterns, labels, and application code were not changed.

summary.method: Loaded every record and inspected every tool step for recorded Invalid JSON input plus validation error, invalid_argument results, and JSON-null searches. Then read full steps of all shortlisted traces. Read actual SDK-generated params_json_schema from tool objects without invoking tools.
summary.definition: Agent supplies arguments rejected by the actual argument validator before tool execution, evidenced by a recorded validation error. Distinguish JSON null from the string null.
boundaries: Expected permission_denied, not_found, not_eligible and paused structured results are not schema validation failures.

Numeric strings such as order_id "3584" or limit "10" can be coerced by the runtime; emitted-schema type mismatch alone is insufficient for this narrow definition when the recorded tool executes successfully.
store "null", "none", or numeric-looking names are strings allowed by schema; failed store resolution is semantic not_found, not pre-execution validation.
Structured ok false invalid_argument may support a broader semantic-argument mode but is not automatically included; none observed in the 337 tool steps.
Assistant text containing JSON is not a recorded tool invocation and is not a successful retry.
summary.checks: Offline cached-trace search and schema inspection only; no live model calls or application tool executions.
summary.requirement_gap: SPEC TOOL-3 names optional price/store inputs; the precise number-or-null type comes from actual function-tool schema. Human should retain this implementation-contract source in the mode definition.

summary.method: Offline retrieval across all cached live-fetched records; inspected selected full records, generation inputs, tool results, and same-session prior turns. Quotes come only from selected trace output. Signals are hypotheses, not labels.
summary.definition: Reply asserts an order field/date/value that disagrees with authorized recorded tool evidence or fills a missing field as if known.
summary.boundary: Verbatim repetition of internally inconsistent record values is a neighboring inconsistency-handling mode. Wrong policy numbers are policy failures. Derived deadline example overlaps policy error and requires human definition review.
summary.uncertainty: No explicit acknowledgement of missing delivered_at found among missing-delivery-date scenarios support-0176 through support-0180. Missing-information acknowledgement close negatives use product details and one placed-order absence case. Cancellation timestamps are unavailable; no actual cancellation date is assumed. No data from other sessions is used as evidence for a selected reply.
summary.checks: Offline cache analysis only; no live model calls, no canonical state/code writes, no labels accepted.

summary.methods: Inspected all TOOL order records structurally for reversed dates, status/date conflicts and explicit null required values; searched all final replies for anomaly/missing-information acknowledgments; inspected all shortlisted user requests, generation outputs, calls, results and final replies. Catalog negative-price pair included as a boundary hypothesis.
summary.checks: Offline inspection of already live-fetched records; no new model calls, labels, scores, canonical state or application code changes.

summary.status: Search hypotheses only; no human judgments or canonical state writes.
summary.definition_candidate: A non-refund Cartwheel case requires human handling under ESC-2, ESC-3, or ESC-4, and no relevant successful escalate_to_human exists by end of current turn, including earlier same-session turns.
summary.boundary: Actual account changes/disputes and explicitly unresolved in-scope requests require tickets. Informational general policy questions do not. SCOPE-2 refusals do not. ESC-1 above-threshold refund queueing belongs to separate issue_refund mode.
summary.findings: Four actual-dispute positive candidates; two explicitly unresolved product comparison candidates; one weaker lost-order candidate. All nine account-change opening scenarios support-0161 through support-0169 successfully escalated. No strong ESC-4 action-policy uncertainty candidate selected.

source: 344 live-fetched cached traces; current rescan offline
definition: A platform/store policy claim lacks an identifier whose existing document supports it; missing, nonexistent and wrong-document IDs qualify.
excluded: Concrete current-tool facts: actual ticket SLA, order status/dates, and refund eligibility flag.
method: Read revised SPEC including RESP-6 and human-confirmed pattern history; reread all final replies/metadata using retrieval filters; inspected actual cited documents and shortlisted tool activity, including retained session tool messages.
limits: Search signals and candidate kinds are hypotheses, never formal labels or prevalence estimates.
Existing-ID counts do not measure support: semantic document-claim comparison is necessary.
Nonexistent-ID counts include failed lookups and exempt factual statements.
Borderline SLA hypothesis contains strong exemption counterevidence and is left pending for explicit human review.
RESP-6 applies to separate task-completion mode; citation source remains PURPOSE-1/RESP-1.
